headline: TEX @ BOS matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TEX 3.86 at BOS 3.21, with a projected total of 7.07. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: TEX moved -0.12 runs while BOS moved -0.29, changing the projected margin by +0.17 runs. The projected total fell -0.41, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +18.2%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Sonny Gray has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Josh Jung, Ceddanne Rafaela, Ezequiel Duran, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Nate Eaton, Justin Foscue because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
